description.value: Dover Chinese Food has been serving Szechuan and Cantonese cuisine to the Nanaimo area since 2000, operating as a takeout and delivery restaurant with a broad menu spanning appetizers, soups, chow mein, fried rice, chop suey, and deep-fried specialties. The kitchen offers generous portions of Chinese-Canadian favourites like almond chicken, deep-fried prawns, and sweet and sour pork, alongside a dedicated vegetarian section. Family and group meal packages are available for up to eight people.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides strong evidence for this listing. Takeout and delivery are explicitly stated on the homepage ('Fresh Chinese Take-Out and Delivery'), and a dedicated Vegetarian Dishes section appears on the menu page. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site. The phone number and address on the website match the OSM tags (unit 103 confirmed).
concerns: OSM address field is empty; full address sourced from website (103-6330 Dover Rd, Nanaimo, BC V9V 1S4).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible takeout restaurant operating since 2000 with a live website and confirmed contact details. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a hot meal or large-group order.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page includes a dedicated 'Vegetarian Dishes' section with Mushroom Chop Suey, Vegetable Chop Suey, Vegetable Chow Mein, Vegetable Fried Rice, Tofu Chop Suey, and Almond Gai Ding with Tofu
